title.en: Unify Open and Private access labels
title.zh: 统一 Open 与专属访问类型文案

purpose.en: Apply the shared access-type UI vocabulary on greatlovemeta.com: Open replaces visible Public product labels, while Private remains English and uses 专属 plus the product name in Chinese.
purpose.zh: 在 greatlovemeta.com 应用共享访问类型界面规范：英文产品标签以 Open 取代 Public；Private 英文保持不变，中文统一为“专属 + 产品名”。

en: Show Open for publicly discoverable product types and keep Private for invitation-only product types.
Use explicit product names such as Open course and Private course instead of ambiguous standalone access words.
zh: 公开可发现的产品类型使用“公开 + 产品名”，仅限受邀的类型使用“专属 + 产品名”。
使用“公开课程”“专属课堂”等完整产品名称，避免单独且含义模糊的访问词。

en: Course, channel, college, program, or meeting surfaces present on this site
zh: 产品访问类型标签与说明
本站现有的课程、频道、学院、节目或会议界面

en: Change user-visible terminology without changing public/private policy enums, authorization checks, database values, or cloud boundaries.
Remove stale Chinese access labels such as 私有, 私密, 私立, and 私课 from product-type copy.
Add or update regression contracts for the shared vocabulary.
zh: 仅修改面向用户的术语，不改变 public/private 策略枚举、权限判断、数据库值或云资源边界。
从产品类型文案中移除“私有、私密、私立、私课”等旧中文访问标签。
新增或更新共享词汇回归门禁。

en: Shared site policy and portfolio architecture gates passed.
Access-label regression tests and production build passed before publication.
Production release and Project report are verified against the exact commit.
zh: 共享网站规则与全站架构门禁通过。
发布前通过访问类型文案回归测试与本站生产构建。
正式部署与项目报告按精确 commit 完成验证。

en: Cross-site interactive realtime browser testing remains intentionally out of scope for this UI terminology rollout.
zh: 本次界面术语迁移按规则不执行跨站实时互动浏览器测试。

en: Preserve greatlovemeta.com branding, routes, independent data, and cloud resources.
zh: 保留 greatlovemeta.com 的品牌、路由、独立数据与云资源。
